reason: The study requires an actual DSA endorsement for the election, not membership or a later Socialists in Office affiliation. A January2025 City & State report says Hanif was not seeking a DSA endorsement in this race. Democratic Left subsequently reported admission to the Socialists in Office bloc in2026. Neither the recovered2025 questionnaires nor that later affiliation establishes a2025 endorsement. The questionnaires remain discovery material, not an added endorsed-primary case.
limits: This disposition does not claim an exhaustive search proving no endorsement ever occurred. Revisit if a direct dated2025 endorsement source is recovered. Hanif's presence as another Democrat in the2021 Brandon West primary is unaffected.
